text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak holds a political meeting to evaluate Egypt's efforts to save the peace process and review the coming contacts with all parties.
- Fifty companies will be offered for sale to foreign investors in world markets.

- The Central Bank of Egypt said in its latest monthly report that bank deposits at the end of March were 157.7 billion pounds ($46.5 billion) against 138.77 billion at the end of the same month of the previous year.
- Mubarak tells the conference of African information ministers that African media is responsible for protecting the identity of the continent.
- Tourism Minister Mamdouh el-Beltagi said that several major tourist agents have asked to hold New Year celebrations for the year 2000 in Egypt.
- Mubarak to receive African information ministers today. The meeting will be atteneded by the Secretary-General of the Organisation of African Unity, Salim Ahmed Salim.
- The Social Fund reduces interest rates on its loans to seven from eight percent.
